attr.title: The Sealed Belfry
attr.desc: A witch, a frozen night, and a bell that has not rung in nine years. A puzzle platformer: walk the novices' path inside the mountain, learn the words carved in stone, and write the runes that undo the Hush.
attr.inst: Ready to run: the game is included. The first start downloads PortMaster's Godot 4.7.1 and Weston runtimes (Wi-Fi needed once).
